title: 🚨Bitcoin's Second Failed Bounce in Two Weeks — Targets Lower.
rawDescription: Two weeks, two failed bounces. Bitcoin's recovery to $77,500 just collapsed — confirming the bull trap — and BTC is opening at $75,400, the lowest of the week.
